info.title: Microsoft Entra Agent ID
info.description: Dual-purpose Microsoft Entra Agent ID connector. Use the MCP endpoint to give an AI agent tools for the agent identity lifecycle, or call the named actions directly from Power Automate and Logic Apps. Covers blueprints, blueprint principals, agent identities, and agent users on Microsoft Graph v1.0, plus workload identity federation for third-party agents on AWS, n8n, and Kubernetes, inheritable permissions, and the beta surfaces for agent risk detection, inherited permissions, Conditional Access what-if, and the agent registry.

post.description: Model Context Protocol endpoint. Accepts JSON-RPC 2.0 requests and exposes the Microsoft Entra Agent ID tools, resources, and prompts to MCP clients such as Copilot Studio.
